**What:** a Halloween variant of the current app icon for both App Store and Google Play.
**Direction (Robert):** keep it as simple as the current icon. The Sep 17 Halloween concept in #zombie-art was too busy at icon size. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkin/fog/prop/title treatment) on top of the current art; same background, pose and composition.

**Dates (Arthur's Q4 release calendar):**
- Concept for Robert's sign-off: Fri Oct 10
- Final iOS + Android icon assets to engineering: Tue Oct 14
- Must be merged by the Oct 16 12:00 PT merge cut; ships in the Oct 17 submission, iOS live ~Wed Oct 22 after review
- Google Play icon: upload Tue Oct 21 (1-day review) so both stores switch ~Oct 22
- Back to the normal icon in the Nov 6 submission

ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art). For the Thu Oct 2 Halloween review. Comment anywhere.
Tracker (every line item, maker, due date): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JID5a5N-BvA2J0invQvfz5UPoMxqzSTJsrzIAf-jk2k/edit

1. Goal
Everything players see from us looks like Halloween for the last stretch of October: the App Store and Google Play pages and every Unity ad we're running (Leonard, #zombie_marketing, Sep 30).

2. Inputs
- Live creatives sheet (Frederick): 4 store surfaces and 56 Unity creatives. Two more live ads aren't on the sheet and are included here: ART-826 julia 4:5 static ("They're coming, stop them!"), our best iOS UK CPI per Frederick's Trello note, and ART-831 Marcus's portrait UA end card, which plays after every Android US phone video. Total: 58 ads.
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12 draft + Sep 30 changes, which replace the draft): Halloween flight is Sat Oct 18 - Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12, so nothing that only runs there gets a Halloween version. Every Halloween ad must be with Frederick by Wed Oct 15 (not Oct 17), so Unity can approve it before the flight. Per his Sep 29 note, squirrelfail landscape and mrfluffernot landscape were taken off iOS UK tablet and now run only on Android US tablet.
- Arthur's Q4 release calendar: merge cut Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT, submit Fri Oct 17, the last build that can carry Halloween. iOS icon and screenshots only change with a build, so they are due at the cut and go live ~Wed Oct 22 (Apple review up to 3 days). Google Play listing graphics can go up any day with 1-day review. Nov 6 submission puts icon and screenshots back to normal.
- Robert's seasonal art direction (Q4 deck): the seasonal layer goes on top of current art only. Anything captured or rendered before Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (Jul 29 zombie swap + new background) is redone on the current build first; if a newer capture replaced it, the newest one counts. A video with music baked into its master is re-cut from a no-music master first. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment); same background, pose, zombie order and CTA, so each variant tests clean against its normal version.
- Already made: Martin's Halloween iPhone 6.5" set (5 screens) and Google Play phone set (6 screens), exported Sep 30 to ZM3D Halloween 2025 / Store. Marcus's Halloween cheer fastcouch 9:16 and 16:9, made from the no-music #1896 masters, in ZM3D Halloween 2025 / UA masters. Leonard confirmed exported store art needs no tickets.

3. The calls (Robert's vocabulary)
- Halloween version: current build, no baked music. Dress it directly.
- Refresh first: re-capture, re-render or re-cut on the current build, then dress it.
- Reuse: a Halloween version already exists. Use it.
- Skip: no Halloween version this time.

4. Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): NEW ART, Martin, ART-855. No approved Halloween icon exists; Robert said Martin's Sep 17 concept was too busy at icon size and it must stay as simple as the current one. Concept to Robert Fri Oct 10, final assets to engineering Tue Oct 14, merged by the Oct 16 12:00 PT cut. iOS goes live ~Oct 22 with the build. Google Play: upload Tue Oct 21 so both stores switch around Oct 22.
  On "swap the icon around the 24th": on iOS the icon is in the build, so it switches when the Oct 17 build clears review (~Oct 22); we can't choose the 24th, and there's no other build before Nov 6. Google Play could switch on the 24th (upload Oct 23), but I'd recommend matching iOS on ~Oct 22. Decision for Thursday.
- iPhone 6.5" set: REUSE Martin's export. Goes up with the Oct 17 submission, live ~Oct 22.
- iPad 12.9" set: NEW ART, Martin, ART-856. The only store set with no Halloween version. Same comps as the live iPad set + seasonal layer, matching the iPhone set. Target Tue Oct 14; hard deadline Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT.
- Google Play phone set: REUSE Martin's export. Upload Fri Oct 17 so it's live ~Sat Oct 18 with the ad flight.
- Nov 6: Arthur reverts icon and screenshots.

5. Ads (58 live today) - summary
- Refresh first: 35 (Marcus 29 videos/end cards, Martin 6 statics)
- Halloween version: 11 (Marcus)
- Reuse: 2 (ART-808 cheer fastcouch 9:16, ART-816 cheer fastcouch 16:9)
- Skip: 10 (only on Android US tablet, which ends Oct 12: ART-806, 811, 813, 820, 821, 822, 824, 842, 844, 849)
Line-by-line calls, sources and reasons are in the tracker's Ads tab and on each ART ticket.

Things worth knowing:
- Nearly all video was captured in April-July or from the prototype (Dec 2024), before #1452, so most of the work is Refresh first. Many refreshes share one capture across aspect ratios (couch boss 30 9:16/16:9; cinematicTutorial 9:16/16:9; tutorialCinematic 9:16/1:1; cheer 30p 9:16/4:5; boris alin2 9:16/16:9), so the real number of re-captures is lower than 29.
- Some edits already have current-build captures in another ratio: couch alpha 50 (#1935, ART-853), balloons alpha 50 (1) (#1966, ART-854), barrel marketing2 (#1896, ART-852). Marcus can start the 9:16/16:9/4:5 refreshes of those from that footage.
- Music baked in: ART-796, 798, 799, 802, 807, 847, plus ART-809 (marcus.bennett 9:16; Marcus already exported a no-music master on Aug 13, so it's a re-cut, not a re-capture).
- ART-831 (portrait UA end card) was rendered from #1450, two builds before the swap, so it needs a refresh. It's not on the live sheet but plays after every Android US phone video.
- ART-826 (julia 4:5) is our best iOS UK performer: Martin does it first.
- cheer fastcouch 4:5 (ART-851) gets its own Halloween version. Marcus's existing Halloween cuts are 9:16 and 16:9 only.

6. Who makes what, by when
- Marcus (video + end cards): 29 Refresh first + 11 Halloween version = 40 deliverables. Refreshed masters by Wed Oct 8; all Halloween versions to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- Martin (icon + stills): 6 julia statics (Refresh first): refreshed by Wed Oct 8, Halloween versions to Frederick by Wed Oct 15. Icon (ART-855) and iPad set (ART-856) as above.

7. Risks / decisions for Thursday
- Marcus's load: 40 deliverables in two weeks is a lot. Options: Julia (who made the statics) or Martin take some end-card passes; or prioritize by spend and accept that low-spend creatives keep running unthemed. Need Frederick's spend ranking to decide.
